description: Free annual winter solstice festival on Sorrento Foreshore. Two stages of live music and DJs. Fire performers and 6-metre handcrafted burning effigy on the bay at 6:30pm. Illuminated lantern path. Projection art on historic buildings. Food trucks. Local producers beer and wine. Silent disco. Sound healing workshops. Family activities. Saturday 20 June + Solstice Sunrise Swim Sunday 21 June.
